Order fulfillment, shipping, and warehouse operations across the region depend on the systems at this site staying available. Partner with operations leadership to ensure technology uptime directly supports shipping SLAs and order-fulfillment throughput. Troubleshoot integrations between warehouse and shipping tools and core business systems, including Oracle EBS (ERP) and Salesforce (CRM). Identify and drive improvements that reduce recurring downtime or manual workaround in the fulfillment workflow. End-User & Endpoint Support Provide on-site and remote support for local end users across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android. Manage endpoint provisioning, security, and lifecycle through Microsoft Intune and Microsoft 365; support conference-room AV and local print services. Act as the escalation point for the service desk on complex, site-specific issues. Security Operations Operate within and help enforce enterprise cybersecurity tooling and policy at the site. Assist with alert triage, vulnerability remediation, and incident response in coordination with the information security team. Uphold access control, least-privilege, and change control standards, including privileged access management practices for site systems. Working familiarity with core security concepts: MFA, least-privilege access, endpoint protection, and patch management. Demonstrated ability to work independently as the senior on-site technical presence while collaborating effectively with a geographically distributed team. Experience managing business AV systems (conference room tech, TV content, etc.) Preferred Qualifications Direct experience supporting warehouse and distribution technology — WMS platforms, shipping software, barcode scanners, and industrial label printers. Hands-on exposure to Azure, Oracle OCI, or AWS. Scripting and automation experience with PowerShell or Python. Experience with enterprise security tooling (Palo Alto Cortex XDR, or similar) and ITSM platforms (Freshservice). Prior experience as the sole or lead technical resource at a distributed site. Relevant certifications: CompTIA Network+ or Security+, Microsoft MS-102 or AZ-104, VMware VCP, or Cisco CCNA. Occasional lifting (up to 50lbs) and hands-on work with equipment in a warehouse environment; occasional travel to other Core Health & Fitness locations may be required. AMHS Administrators monitor, maintain, and control mid‑range application servers hosting AMHS services, ensuring message delivery, routing integrity, and system availability. Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and message‑flow issues such as routing failures, queue corruption, and delivery anomalies. Monitor server performance, message throughput, storage usage, and system health to ensure optimal operation. Conduct backups, recovery actions, and continuity‑of‑operations procedures to maintain message retention and system resilience. Build AMHS servers and integrate enclaves while ensuring compliance with DoD messaging standards and SIE configuration requirements. Support virtual components used by AMHS operators and message center personnel. Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for AMHS administration, workflows, and enclave configurations. Provide system administration for environments hosting complex databases, routing tables, configuration controls, and system interfaces. Create, maintain, and troubleshoot AMHS user accounts and application‑specific anomalies. Maintain file servers, network access, and connectivity; document and resolve performance‑impacting issues.
